EPIC SCOPE CLARIFICATION (2026-05-18) — three explicit non-goals to prevent further scope regression.

NON-GOAL 1: This epic does NOT modify CI workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) or branch ruleset configuration beyond what is strictly required by stories already shipped. Workflow remediation (restoring per-sub-PR LLM review, fixing incremental-scope review at session→main, no-duplicate-checks invariant) is scoped to a SEPARATE REMEDIATION EPIC.

NON-GOAL 2: This epic does NOT delete, deprecate, or replace existing review infrastructure. Workflow invariants needed by this epic's new machinery must be achieved via additive coordination (e.g. ledger keying), not subtractive deletion. The destructive deletion of per-branch-review.yml in story 20d7-09d6 is acknowledged as a regression (tracked under post-mortem bug 576b-a6c7-3de3-4eef) to be reversed by the remediation epic.

NON-GOAL 3: Story c4f1-c18d-0000-4001 (SC10) is paused until the remediation epic restores per-sub-PR review coverage. SC10 has been split into SC10a (sub-PR arbiter validation) and SC10b (epic-PR arbiter validation) — see c4f1 comments. SC10a/b cannot be validated until the corrected two-tier review surface exists.

BLOCKED-BY-EPIC: this epic is blocked on the upcoming remediation epic. Epic b575 cannot close (because c4f1 is open) until remediation epic ships.

P0 bugs e486-2d01 and b1a7-20bf (already moved out of this epic to orphan tickets 9778-3525 and 576b-a6c7 respectively) document scope-failure patterns that will be addressed via dedicated focused work AFTER remediation epic.
